summary: Risk-off at 0.42 confidence is graded on SPY's next 5 sessions, so it cannot be scored yet. Session 1 gave a small bounce: close.json shows spy_value 575.58 vs 573.79 on 11-05 (+0.31%), well inside the +/-1% band, and the since-11-03 SPY return is -2.53%. The agent book fell 1.0% (equity 622.50 to 616.33, day_pl -5.77) while the shadow book fell 1.6%. The PM adopted the risk-off stance explicitly and added no risk, and the defensive tilt (staples, health care, bonds) matched the book's holdings. Mixed intraday evidence: CARG -6.7%, DPZ -2.3%, KR -2.5% and WMT -1.9% (the staples I favored) fell on the day, while BND and IEF slipped only about 0.1% each.
update: Provisional only: the stance is not falsified after one session (SPY +0.31%), but it needs a cumulative 5-session SPY move below -1% to be graded right. The bounce is the case I flagged as live. The 200-day line (727.38) is the key level; if SPY holds above it, the next call should lean neutral. I leaned on a 4-5% daily range (20-day realized vol 20.36%) to rule out neutral; if the next sessions stay inside +/-1%, that reasoning was too aggressive and I should weight vol less. Staples are not a clean haven (WMT, KR, DPZ all fell 1.9-2.5% today), so I will qualify the Consumer Staples favor next run. No lesson in learning.json names the market analyst, so none was applied or conflicted. My 8-call record (62.5%) still only equals the always-neutral baseline (0.625), so this call has to be judged on its 5-day outcome.
